Southern Illinois University

Something for everyone, Southern Illinois University is your place for college in Illinois.

Register for Spring

Imagine the possibilities.

A university promoting access and opportunity. Where outstanding teaching fuels research and creativity. Where students become leaders and transform lives. SIU. Making it real.

River Region News returns

The student-run newscast is back after nearly six years on hiatus, bringing campus and regional news to viewers on Facebook, Instagram and YouTube platforms.
Harvesting fall crops

Student workers at University Farms are gaining hands-on experience operating combines during the fall harvest season, bringing their agricultural coursework to life.
Disease-detecting robot

SIU researchers design a robot and program its artificial intelligence models to detect soybean diseases before symptoms appear.

IT’S A SALUKI NATION

Ways to make your education
investment count

No out-of-state Tuition Saluki Commitment Scholarships Financial Aid

At a Glance

11:1
Student-Faculty Ratio
Lower than national average ratio means small class sizes
3,000
Outdoor Education
Over 3,000 acres of hills and forest for outdoor education and adventure
200+
Majors, Minors, and Specializations
More opportunities for a tailored education
69M
Grants
$69 million in external grants awarded for research and service last year

Be part of this

I am a future:

Saluki spotlight

Certified Wilderness First Responder. Leave No Trace master instructor. High ropes course instruction. Not a bad way to make the Dean’s List. Rockette Jaros, Recreation Professions major.
